name: Enzo Catalán Vargas
headline: Full Stack Developer · 6+ years | React · Angular · Node.js · NestJS
summary: Full Stack Developer with 6+ years of experience building web applications and backend services with NestJS and React for banking, telecommunications, healthcare, and logistics clients in Peru, Chile, Argentina, Colombia, and Spain. 3+ years at NTT DATA on projects for Banco de Crédito del Perú, Santander, Telefónica de Argentina, WOM, Clínica Alemana, and Correos Express: frontend and full-stack development (microservices and micro-frontends) and platform support (Jenkins pipelines and remediation of 20 security vulnerabilities). At KURAX I provide support for legacy systems, build new projects, and have integrated 3 external providers. In personal projects I build multi-tenant SaaS platforms with Next.js, NestJS, and Go, and an e-invoicing microservice for SUNAT, Peru's tax authority.
